information_list.title: The race event Champions Meeting: Aquarius Cup is here!
information_list.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Nov 21, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Aquarius Cup has begun!
 Champions Meeting: Aquarius Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 21–9:59 p.m., Nov 27, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 17–9:59 p.m., Nov 25, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Nov 21, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Nov 23, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Nov 25, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Nov 21–9:59 p.m., Nov 23, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Nov 23–9:59 p.m., Nov 25, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 25–9:59 a.m., Nov 26, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Nov 26–9:59 p.m., Nov 26, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 26–9:59 p.m., Nov 27, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Tokyo / Dirt / 1,600m (Mile) / Left-Handed / Winter / Snowy / Soft / Afternoon

 The following skills will not activate in this Aquarius Cup:
 • Collaborative Graded Races ◎
 • Collaborative Graded Races ○
 • Collaborative Graded Races ×

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either an Aquarius Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either an Aquarius Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 It is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 The ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Aquarius Cup Platinum
 • Aquarius Cup Gold
 • Aquarius Cup Silver
 • Aquarius Cup Bronze

 If you reobtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Aquarius Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to Champions Meeting under Races in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the Menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

information_list.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby × Denver Broncos Collaboration Event Coming Dec 6!
information_list.message:
Umamusume: Pretty Derby is partnering with the NFL's Denver Broncos to hold a collaborative event! The event will take place on Sunday, Dec 6 (MST), during the Broncos' Week 13 game at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver, Colorado.


Event Features

 On gameday, Umamusume will be featured on the horseshoe-shaped LED ribbon and venue screens throughout Empower Field at Mile High, home of the Denver Broncos! An Umamusume-themed fan cam will also be on the lookout during the game.


 At the East Rock Garden near Gate 8 of the stadium, there will be an event-exclusive collaboration booth featuring life-sized cutouts of Gold Ship and Mejiro McQueen donning the Broncos uniform for photo opportunities. Trainers can also receive a postcard featuring the same illustration, as well as a complimentary rally flag featuring a special illustration of Gold Ship scoring a touchdown in a Broncos uniform! Both artworks were created especially for this collaboration.

Collaboration Booth Details

  • Time: 11:05 a.m.–2:05 p.m., Dec 6, 2026 (MST)
  • Location: Empower Field at Mile High – East Rock Garden (near Gate 8)
    •  *A game ticket is not required to visit the collaboration booth or receive the giveaways.

Game Details

  • Time: 2:05 p.m., Dec 6, 2026 (MST)
  • Venue: Empower Field at Mile High, Denver, Colorado
  • Tickets: Tickets for the game will be sold via Ticketmaster

 *Event date, times, and contents are subject to change without notice.
 *Images and services shown are in development and may differ on the day of the event.

 • Collaborative Graded Races ◎
 • Collaborative Graded Races ○
 • Collaborative Graded Races ×

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either an Aquarius Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either an Aquarius Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 It is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 The ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Aquarius Cup Platinum
 • Aquarius Cup Gold
 • Aquarius Cup Silver
 • Aquarius Cup Bronze

 If you reobtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Aquarius Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to Champions Meeting under Races in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the Menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

information_list.title: Valentine's Day celebration coming soon!
information_list.message:
At 10:00 p.m., Nov 24, 2026 (UTC), our Valentine's Day celebration is set to begin!

 At 10:00 p.m., Nov 24, 2026 (UTC), a special Valentine's gift event is set to begin!
 For the duration of this event, you can receive a Valentine's gift each day from one of your Trainee Umamusume.

 There are two types of Valentine's gift available in this event: Handmade Chocolate and Special Chocolate.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 24–2:59 p.m., Dec 1, 2026 (UTC)

 How to Receive Valentine's Gifts

 During this event, a special Valentine's Day event button will be displayed on the Home screen. Select this button, select a tab to choose whether to receive a Handmade Chocolate or a Special Chocolate, then choose an Umamusume from the trainees in your roster.
 The selected trainee will give you a Valentine's Day gift.
 • Regardless of which type of chocolate you receive, you can only receive one Valentine's gift per day.
 • If you possess multiple Trainee Umamusume with the same name but different costumes, you can receive Handmade Chocolate and/or Special Chocolate separately from each of them.

 About Handmade Chocolates

 Handmade Chocolates are available to receive from all Trainee Umamusume in your roster regardless of Bond Level.

 After receiving a Handmade Chocolate from a Trainee Umamusume, you will not be able to receive another from the same Trainee Umamusume during this event period.

 About Special Chocolates

 Generally, Special Chocolates can only be received from Umamusume with a Bond Level of 9 or above.
 However, the first time you receive a Special Chocolate during this event period, you can choose to receive it from any Trainee Umamusume in your roster regardless of Bond Level.

 You can receive Special Chocolate from the same Umamusume as many times as you like.
 What's more, even after you have received your Valentine's gift for the day, you can still view the Special Chocolate scene for other Umamusume.
 (When viewing Special Chocolate scenes in this way, you will not receive an item. Only Umamusume with a Bond Level of 9 or above are available to view.)

 At 10:00 p.m., Nov 24, 2026 (UTC), an Increased Bond Points event is set to begin!
 During this event, you will earn more Bond Points when playing Careers and Team Trials.

 Earning Bond Points allows you to increase your Bond Level with your trainees.
 Increasing Bond Level allows you to unlock episodes of each trainee's Umamusume Story.

 Don't miss this opportunity to explore stories you have yet to experience!

 Important Information

 1. For more information on this event, please refer to the notice that will be posted when the event begins.
 2. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

information_list.title: Information regarding LA concert cancellation reimbursement and online merchandise sales
information_list.message:
Thank you for your continued support of Umamusume: Pretty Derby.

 Please read the following for information regarding the reimbursement process for concert ticket purchases, travel fees, and cancellation fees, as well as how to purchase concert merchandise. These details are being provided through this web notice instead of via email as originally planned.

 We acknowledge that the announcement of this information has taken longer than expected, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and concern caused by the delay.

 If you would like to receive reimbursement or purchase concert merchandise, please submit the required information to the designated Cygames email address by the deadline.

 *If you have already submitted the required information to Cygames, you do not have to submit the same information again.
 *Emails must be written in English or Japanese.

 Deadline

11:59 p.m., November 30, 2026 (PT)


 If you would like to receive reimbursement or purchase concert merchandise, submit the required information by the above deadline. You will receive further instructions to submit receipts, bank account information, etc.

 *Requests for reimbursement submitted after the deadline might not be fulfilled.

 You will receive a separate email from AXS regarding concert ticket refunds.

 Reimbursement

 If you traveled:

 • Lodging Expenses
 You will be reimbursed for actual costs incurred for up to two nights of lodging if you had ticket(s) to attend one of the two concerts, or up to three nights if you had tickets to attend both days. The maximum amount covered will be USD 320 or JPY 50,000 per person per night.
 • Air Travel to Los Angeles
 You will be reimbursed for actual costs incurred for round-trip flight tickets, including fuel surcharges and airport taxes. The maximum amount covered will be USD 4,450 or JPY 700,000 per person.

 If you cancelled bookings without traveling:

 You will be reimbursed in full for any cancellation fees incurred. The above reimbursement limits for lodging and air travel expenses do not apply in this case.

 Concert Merchandise

 If you would like to purchase concert merchandise online, you will receive further instructions on how to do so after the information you provided is verified.

 Those residing in the US or Canada may purchase merchandise from the site linked below. Merchandise will be on sale until 11:59 p.m., November 16 (PT).
https://www.goodsmileus.com/

 Where to Submit Information

 ts7th_umamusume_la_support@contact.cygames.co.jp

 For more on the handling of your personal information, refer to the Cygames, Inc. Privacy Policy.

 If you perform 25 spins on a single bingo sheet, that sheet's spin quota is fulfilled, and any subsequent spins are guaranteed to land on segments you have not yet filled in.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on story events, please tap the Help icon on the top right of the event screen.
 2. Event Points earned in this event cannot be carried over to future events.
 3. Prize Coins earned in this event will be converted into monies after the reward collection period has ended.
 4. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.
 5. Additional Event Bonus Umamusume and Event Bonus Support Cards may become available during the event.

information_list.title: New title missions are here!
information_list.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Nov 9, 2026 (UTC), new titles have been added, along with corresponding missions to obtain them.

 The new titles and the conditions to earn them are as follows.

 Titles and Missions

 Career:
 • "Early Racer Gets the Carrot" - Win all races and clear all Career goals without using a retry
 • "Power of Friendship" - Complete a Career playthrough having triggered Friendship Training at least 60 times
 • "Nothing Beats Experience" - Complete a Career playthrough having run at least 35 races
 • "Spark God" - Achieve a 3★ spark in attribute, aptitude, and Unique Skill in a single Career playthrough
 • "Expert Front Runner" - Achieve Front Runner aptitude S 30 times
 • "Expert Pace Chaser" - Achieve Pace Chaser aptitude S 30 times
 • "Expert Late Surger" - Achieve Late Surger aptitude S 30 times
 • "Expert End Closer" - Achieve End Closer aptitude S 30 times
 • "Sprint Expert" - Achieve Sprint aptitude S 30 times
 • "Mile Expert" - Achieve Mile aptitude S 30 times
 • "Medium Expert" - Achieve Medium aptitude S 30 times
 • "Long Expert" - Achieve Long aptitude S 30 times
 • "Turf Expert" - Achieve Turf aptitude S 30 times
 • "Dirt Expert" - Achieve Dirt aptitude S 30 times

 Team Trials:
 • "One, Two, Three!" - Place 1st, 2nd, and 3rd in a Team Trial 1 time
 • "Utter Domination" - Place 1st, 2nd, and 3rd in a Team Trial 5 times
 • "Mejiro Family" - Win a Team Trials race with a specific combination of Umamusume
 • "BNW" - Win a Team Trials race with a specific combination of Umamusume
 • "Student Council" - Win a Team Trials race with a specific combination of Umamusume
 • "Eternal Top Three" - Win a Team Trials race with a specific combination of Umamusume

 Main Story:
 • "First Blessing" - Win Main Story Act 1, Chapter 2, Race 1
 • "Triumph over Nightmares" - Win Main Story Act 1, Chapter 3, Race 3
 • "Conqueror" - Win Main Story Act 1, Chapter 4, Race 3
 • "The Way You Want" - Win Main Story Act 1, Chapter 5, Race 2
 • "I Have to Win!" - Win Main Story Act 1, Finale Part 1, Race 2
 • "Japan's Number One" - Win Main Story Act 1, Finale Part 2, Race 7

 Important Information

 1. Only progress made after this update will count toward completing the newly added missions.
 2. To complete the mission "Early Racer Gets the Carrot," you will need to win all races entered during that Career, not only the goal races.
 3. Team races in the Career Scenario Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit! do not count towards mission progress for "Early Racer Gets the Carrot" and "Nothing Beats Experience."
 4. When calculating mission progress for "Power of Friendship," if multiple training partners trigger Friendship Training on the same turn, each partner counts as a separate activation.
 For example: If two training partners are displayed on Speed training with a rainbow icon, and you select to train Speed for that turn, this will increase your mission progress by two.
 5. When attempting the Team Trials missions added in this update, you must enter the relevant races with a full team of three members.
